heading: Today
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 50s to around 60. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley, becoming west to northwest in the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy north; mainly clear south. Lows in the upper 20s lower 30s east of the Greens, and mainly mid to upper 30s west. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Saturday
text: Partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 50s to around 60. Winds variable to south around 5 mph, except from the south at 5 to 10 mph and gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain Valley.
